card.name: The word bleeding in drug warnings
card.fires_on: The word "bleeding" (once also "circulated") in drug-label text, usually after words like increased, if, GI, or the. It fires on bleeding as a risk, time, or event.

modes.label: Bleeding as risk or event
modes.description: The word bleeding after a linking or modifying word in warnings about anticoagulants, aspirin, or similar drugs.
modes.example: Coadministration of rivaroxaban with STRIBILD is not recommended because it may lead to an increased<< bleeding>> risk.

modes.label: Stray word circulated
modes.description: The word circulated after widely, in a web article about an e-mail claim.
